senses.gloss: (טוּל, טְלַל, v. אַמְטוּל; cmp. גִּין) on account of, for the sake of.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:8">Targ. Y. I Num. XXV, 8</cite> <he>מ׳ אליין</he> on account of these persons.
Targ. Ps. XLIV, 27 (h. text למען).—מ׳ ד־ because, for.
Targ. Ps. I, 6.—מ׳ היכנא, מ׳ הכי therefore (h. על כן).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 1:5">Ib. 5</cite>. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 1:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>מ׳ היכנא</he> ed. Wil., strike out <he>מ׳</he>, as ed. Lag.]—
Ib. XLIX, 15; a. fr.—מְטוּלְתִּי for my sake, מְטוּלְתָּךְ for thy sake, &c.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 8:15">Targ. Prov. VIII, 15</cite>, sq. Ms. (ed. <he>מטול אנא</he>!).—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 115:1">Targ. Ps. CXV, 1</cite>; a. fr.
